Prove or exactly obstruct that the dressed canonical transformation and measure Jacobian generate only local counterterms, establish the QAP hypotheses and filtration continuity, and then state precisely whether H_ext^{1,4}=0 authorizes the all-orders local QME induction for this changed action. Account explicitly for evanescent d-dimensional invariants exposed by the DR/MS preflight. Emit an independent regulator/QAP certificate and selected-action receiver contract.
